governing_document: Assam Notified Urban Building Byelaws & Disaster Resilient Construction Standards
authority: Guwahati Development Department / Urban Development, Govt of Assam
climate_adaptations: Warm & Humid with heavy monsoon rainfall (>2000mm/yr).

rules.clause: Byelaw 32 - Construction in Flood Inundation Zones
rules.description: Shelters in designated high flood zones must be constructed on stilts or elevated plinths >= 1.0m above High Flood Level (HFL).
rules.remediation: Elevate base structure on reinforced stilts.

rules.clause: Byelaw 45 - Structural Safety in Zone V
rules.description: All structures must have ductile cross-bracing or reinforced concrete framing meeting IS 13920 specifications.
rules.remediation: Integrate diagonal corner bracing and reinforced lintel bands.
